From the owner
Kitchen Lighting Guide: Best Design Tips for Custom Kitchens Essential Kitchen Lighting Ideas for Your New Custom Kitchen Most homeowners spend weeks choosing custom cabinets and countertops, then make their lighting decisions in an afternoon. That's a mistake. We will show you why you should always overthink your kitchen lighting. Must-know kitchen lighting design tips for your new kitchen start with one core principle: lighting does more work in a kitchen than in almost any other room. It supports prep, cooking, cleaning, and entertaining — often all at once. Get it wrong and even a beautifully designed luxury kitchen feels dim, flat, or frustrating to use. Why Kitchen Lighting Deserves More Thought Than Most Decisions Kitchen lighting affects how you see food, how safe the workspace feels, and how the room looks morning through evening. A single overhead fixture — the default in many new builds — creates shadows on countertops and leaves the edges of the room in gloom. Cooking in those conditions isn't just inconvenient. It can be a safety issue. Lighting also affects how the kitchen feels. A bright, evenly lit space reads as clean and functional. A kitchen with layered, dimmable light sources reads as warm and considered. The difference is rarely about budget — it's about planning. Decisions made early, before walls are closed and cabinets installed, give you far more options and lower installation costs. Click below to read more:

Our Services

Serving discerning Long Island and NYC homeowners for over 42 years through a fully managed design-build process.

Luxury Interior Design

Elite Kitchen & Bath is a design & build firm specializing in luxury kitchen, bath, and home customization.  Our clients come to us when they want more than an upgrade. They want a transformation—one that reflects how they live, entertain, and experience their home.

We offer customized designs including European Architectural Aesthetics, construction and installation. We provide custom cabinetry - American and European imports.

Learn more

Design-Build Firm

We design and build fully custom remodels for discerning homeowners across Long Island’s North Shore and NYC—where architecture, craftsmanship, and modern living come together seamlessly. We are a full-service, licensed and insured general contractor. Our work includes full-home remodeling, kitchens, baths, co-ops, extensions, interior/exterior and more. With us, there’s no need to coordinate between multiple professionals — we manage every detail.

Learn more

Custom Cabinetry, Appliances & Finishes

In addition to design and build services, we are partnered with the top product manufacturers to offer the highest quality materials, cabinetry, appliances, and finishes.  

Learn more

About 
Elite Kitchen & Bath/Express Contracting 

Trusted by North Shore & NYC homeowners seeking elevated design, premium materials, and a truly guided experience from concept through completion.

Elite Kitchen & Bath/Express Contracting provide comprehensive, fully managed design and remodel services for all luxury home and lite-commercial renovations. 

We are a full-service, high-end interior design firm and licensed + insured general contractor — handling everything from consultation and space planning (start) to construction and installation (finish).

With over 42 years of experience and offering a wide selection of luxury, custom cabinetry, we have been the trusted resource for homeowners and businesses across Long Island and NYC, winning multiple industry awards including Contractor of the Year from PRONY and Best In Show by NARI.

Most of our projects come from referrals and repeat clients

DAVID SHARBANI
2024 KITCHEN & BATH DESIGN NEWS INNOVATOR OF THE YEAR

Growing up in the construction business perfects client approach

David Sharbani started working for his father’s construction company when he was just a teenager, and has been in the design and remodeling industry for over 38 years. When he joined his father’s contracting business, his construction education and experience brought a new dimension to the company’s designs and remodels. How a project gets built became the forefront of every design. This angle helped clients attain their dream kitchen, bath, extension or home remodel.Specializing in kitchens and baths is particularly meaningful to him since his mother, born in France, instilled in him a love for fine design and family gatherings. Sharbani’s dad, Yeheskel, was an electrical engineer in a nuclear power plant before starting his construction business. Sharbani learned the art of precision and “do it right the first time” from his father, who insisted on this type of focus.  Today, Sharbani, who is president of Elite Kitchen & Bath in Manhasset, NY, leads a team that starts every project by asking clients how they use their space, and how they would like to use it after it is renovated. These simple questions lead the project design and remodel. His design approach stresses not only aesthetics, but functionality, longevity and ease of use.The firm’s work has been recognized with countless honors, including the Interior Design Society’s DOTY Award and the NARI Platinum & Gold Awards.https://www.kitchenbathdesign.com/david-sharbani/

Bath Brings the Gym’s Spa Experience Home - Kitchen & Bath Design News

Before

The homeowners, a professional couple, recently switched from working out at the gym to working out at home. However, they missed the refuge they found from their stressful day-to-day in the gym experience, including amenities such as a steam room, and wanted to replicate that in their home workout experience.  

After 

By extending the master bathroom into an underutilized second floor terrace, designer David Sharbani of Elite Kitchen & Bath in Manhasset, NY was able to enlarge the bathroom to almost twice its original size, creating enough space to produce the home spa of the clients’ dreams. Top of the clients’ wish list was a zero-clearance frameless recessed steam shower with a bench long enough to lay on, inspired by their love of the steam room at the gym. Hand-laid 4’x8′ shower tiles create the sleek minimalist look the clients craved, while a newly enlarged window bathes the space in natural light for a zen-like experience. Additional luxury touches include a bidet toilet seat, Italian high-gloss vanity and linen closet, heated floors and frameless mirrors.

What Does a Luxury Kitchen Remodel Cost on Long Island?
Luxury Kitchens dominate Long Island's North Shore
Understanding the Investment Behind a Luxury Kitchen Renovation

One of the first questions homeowners ask when planning a kitchen renovation is:

"How much will my kitchen remodel cost?"

The answer depends on many factors, including the size of the space, the level of customization, structural changes, cabinetry selections, appliances, and finish materials.

While every project is unique, understanding the typical investment ranges can help you plan confidently and make informed decisions.

At Elite Kitchen & Bath, we have helped Long Island homeowners transform their kitchens for more than 40 years through our comprehensive design-build process. This guide explains the factors that influence cost and what you can expect when planning a luxury kitchen renovation.

Typical Kitchen Remodeling Investment Ranges on Long Island
Cosmetic Kitchen Update
$35,000 – $60,000+

Suitable for homeowners who wish to refresh an existing kitchen layout while updating finishes.

Typical improvements may include:

New countertops

New backsplash

Semi-Custom Cabinetry 

Updated lighting

New sink and faucet

Limited electrical and plumbing modifications

Best for kitchens where the existing layout functions well and major structural work is not required.

Full Kitchen Renovation
$75,000 – $150,000+

Many Long Island homeowners choose this level of renovation to improve functionality, increase storage, and modernize outdated spaces.

Typical scope may include:

Complete demolition

New cabinetry

Premium countertops

Updated flooring

New appliances

Lighting redesign

Electrical upgrades

Plumbing upgrades

Enhanced storage solution

Luxury Custom Kitchen Renovation
$150,000 – $300,000+

This category includes highly customized projects designed around the homeowner's lifestyle.

Features may include:

Custom luxury cabinetry

Large entertaining islands

Architectural millwork

Professional-grade built-in appliances

Walk-in pantries

Specialty storage systems

Smart home integration

Imported materials

Significant layout modifications

Home bar/Coffee bar 

These kitchens are often designed as the centerpiece of the home and reflect a highly personalized approach.

Estate-Level and Fully Customized Kitchens
$300,000+

These projects typically involve extensive design, engineering, and construction.

They may include:

Structural modifications

Wall removal

Home additions

Custom furniture-quality cabinetry

Integrated luxury appliance packages

Specialty stone fabrication

Extensive architectural detailing

These kitchens are tailored to the unique needs of the homeowner and often become showpiece spaces within the home.

What Has the Biggest Impact on Cost?

Understanding the major cost drivers can help homeowners prioritize their investment.

Cabinetry

Cabinetry is often the largest component of a kitchen renovation budget.

Options generally include:

Stock cabinetry

Semi-custom cabinetry

Fully custom cabinetry

Imported luxury cabinetry

Higher-end cabinetry offers greater customization, improved construction quality, enhanced finishes, and specialized storage solutions.

Countertops

Material selection significantly affects project cost.

Popular luxury options include:

Quartz

Quartzite

Marble

Porcelain

Exotic natural stone

Each material offers unique benefits related to appearance, durability, and maintenance requirements.

Appliances

Appliance selections can vary dramatically depending on brand and functionality.

Luxury kitchens often include:

Built-in refrigeration

Professional cooking appliances

Steam ovens

Wine refrigeration

Integrated coffee systems

Panel-ready appliances

Layout Changes

Projects become more complex when homeowners wish to:

Remove walls

Relocate plumbing

Move gas lines

Add windows or doors

Reconfigure traffic flow

These improvements can significantly enhance functionality but require additional planning and construction.

Lighting

Lighting is one of the most overlooked aspects of kitchen design.

A well-designed lighting plan may include:

Decorative fixtures

Recessed lighting

Under-cabinet lighting

Accent lighting

Interior cabinet lighting

Proper lighting dramatically improves both aesthetics and functionality.

Why Luxury Kitchens Cost More

Luxury kitchens involve more than premium finishes.

They require:

Comprehensive planning

Professional design expertise

Detailed project management

Superior craftsmanship

High-performance materials

Experienced installation teams

The goal is not simply to create a beautiful room but to deliver a space that functions seamlessly for years to come.

How to Budget for Your Kitchen Remodel

When planning a renovation, homeowners should consider:

Lifestyle Needs

Do you frequently entertain?

Do multiple family members cook simultaneously?

Do you require specialized storage?

Understanding how you use the space helps determine where to invest.

Long-Term Value

A thoughtfully designed kitchen can provide daily enjoyment while also enhancing the overall value of your home.

Investing in quality materials and professional installation often delivers greater long-term satisfaction than focusing solely on initial cost.

Future Plans

If you expect to remain in your home for many years, investing in customization and premium materials may provide greater value and enjoyment  over time.

Why Homeowners Choose Elite Kitchen & Bath

For more than four decades, homeowners throughout Long Island have trusted Elite Kitchen & Bath to design and build exceptional kitchens.

Our design-build approach provides:

One dedicated team

Comprehensive project management

Expert design guidance

Premium material selections

Skilled craftsmanship

Transparent communication

From concept through completion, we help homeowners navigate every decision with confidence.

Ready to Explore Your Kitchen Remodeling Investment?

Every kitchen renovation is unique.

The best way to understand the investment required for your project is through a personalized consultation with our design team.

We'll discuss your goals, evaluate your space, and provide guidance tailored to your home, lifestyle, and priorities.

Schedule a complimentary consultation today and begin planning the kitchen you've always envisioned.

Kitchen Remodeling FAQs
Kitchen Design, Remodel & Installation Questions
How do I start a kitchen remodel?

The first step in any kitchen remodeling project is preparation. Gather inspiration photos, any existing plans, and rough measurements of your current kitchen. Schedule a consultation with a professional kitchen designer.

During your initial kitchen design consultation, your designer will review your layout options, design style, color preferences, construction needs, timeline, and overall budget. Bringing photos of kitchens you love helps communicate your vision clearly.

Important: Always hire a fully licensed and insured kitchen contractor with both general liability insurance and workers’ compensation coverage. If a contractor is not properly insured, the homeowner may be financially liable for any job-site injuries.

What decisions are involved in a kitchen remodel?

A successful kitchen renovation requires several key decisions, including:

Keeping the existing kitchen layout or changing the footprint

Selecting and ordering kitchen appliances (required before final design approval)

Choosing cabinet brand, door style, drawer construction, materials, and finishes

Planning kitchen lighting and plumbing locations

Selecting cabinet storage solutions and organizers

Reviewing and approving final kitchen design drawings

Cabinetry cannot be ordered until all designs are finalized and approved.

Should I hire a full-service kitchen remodeling firm or separate contractors?

Hiring a full-service kitchen design and remodeling firm simplifies the entire process. A design/build firm manages kitchen design, cabinetry, construction, and installation from start to finish. They also coordinate countertops, backsplashes, appliances, flooring, plumbing, electrical work, windows, doors, and hardware.

If you hire a separate kitchen designer and contractor, the designer will create the layout and supply cabinetry, while the contractor handles construction. In this case, ensure the designer remains involved throughout the project to support quality control and execution.

Do I need a permit for my kitchen remodel?

Most kitchen remodels require permits, especially when plumbing, electrical, or structural work is involved. Work with a licensed kitchen remodeling contractor who understands local building codes and will obtain all required permits.

What is the kitchen design and installation process?

After your initial meeting, your kitchen designer will present a preliminary design and estimated budget. Once you decide to proceed, a design retainer is typically required and is often applied toward your cabinetry purchase.

Your designer will then take detailed measurements of your kitchen space. The design process continues until the final kitchen layout is approved. A 50% deposit is generally required to place the cabinet order.

If construction work is required, a contractor will evaluate your home and provide an estimate. A design/build firm manages all design, cabinetry, construction, and installation services under one roof.

When should I select my kitchen appliances?

Kitchen appliances must be selected before the design is finalized. Appliance sizes and configurations directly impact cabinetry and layout.

Decisions such as:

Professional range vs. cooktop and wall ovens

Refrigerator size (30”, 36”, 48” or custom columns)

Built-in vs. counter-depth refrigeration

Microwave drawers, steam ovens, wine or beverage units

Hood – Style, size,  vented out or not.

All influence the kitchen design and must be determined early.

What other kitchen selections will I need to make?

In addition to cabinetry and appliances, you’ll also choose:

Kitchen lighting fixtures

Plumbing fixtures

Flooring materials

Backsplash tile

Countertops

Paint colors

Cabinet hardware

Outlet color

Making selections early helps avoid delays, as many appliances and other materials have extended lead times.

Does the cabinet brand matter in a kitchen remodel?

Yes. Cabinet quality significantly affects durability, functionality, and long-term appearance. High-quality custom cabinetry offers superior construction, refined finishes, and longer warranties.

Cabinet options typically fall into three categories:

Luxury custom cabinets: Highest level of craftsmanship and finish

Semi-custom cabinets: Excellent quality with more budget flexibility

Stock cabinets: Best for lower budgets, with construction and finishes aligned with cost

Your kitchen designer can help you choose the best cabinetry for your budget and lifestyle.

How much does a kitchen remodel cost?

Kitchen remodel costs vary widely based on design choices and materials. Cabinetry typically ranges from $10,000 to $150,000, while appliance packages may range from $8,000 to $60,000 or more.

Cabinet quality should align with appliance investment and overall project goals. Labor complexity, materials, finishes, and construction scope all impact total cost. Discussing your budget early helps your designer create a well-balanced plan.

How long does a kitchen renovation take?

The kitchen remodeling timeline begins after final design approval and deposit. Typical lead times include:

Custom kitchen cabinets: 12–15 weeks

Semi-custom cabinets: 6–10 weeks

Stock cabinets: approximately 2 weeks

Construction may begin before cabinetry arrives and can take 1–8 weeks depending on the scope. Cabinet installation typically takes 1–2 weeks.

Can a kitchen designer work with my architect or interior designer?

Yes. Professional kitchen designers regularly collaborate with architects and interior designers. The kitchen designer adapts architectural plans to work seamlessly with cabinetry, appliances, and construction requirements, ensuring a cohesive final result.

Do contractors typically offer remodeling services beyond kitchens?

Yes. Many kitchen design showrooms operate as full-service design/build firms. Licensed contractors can also remodel bathrooms, renovate entire homes, and design and construct home additions.

ELITE KITCHEN & BATH/EXPRESS CONTRACTING REVIEWS 

Lori P.

I LOVE my kitchen ! Remodeling is not for the faint of heart. But with the guidance of Elite Kitchen designer, Robin Dasilva, I was patiently assisted every step of the way through the process. Then when Dave Sharbani & his Express Contracting team did the work I was treated as if I was there only customer. All the workers are polite, neat & professional. They got the job done correctly ...no cutting corners. Not only did I have my kitchen remodeled but I had all my wood floors refinished & the interior painted. Yes it was a big job. I will use them again when I renovate my bathroom a year from now.

Ellen H.

We had our two bathrooms redone and our kitchen completely gutted and redesigned by Yeheskel Sharbani of Elite Kitchen and Bath and Express Contracting. Although the job was a major one and took a long time, the results were worth it! From the start Robin at Elite Kitchen and Sharbani gave us such good advice about the design and fixtures. The showroom was beautiful and everyone was helpful. The people that worked on site were courteous and kept things as neat as they could since we continued to live in the apartment during the remodel. We are very pleased with the results! Our apartment is beautiful!

Learle G

Express Contracting/Elite Kitchen and Bath took my small co-op kitchen, gutted the whole thing, moved the sink, installed 3 kinds of lighting and turned it into a full-size dream of a kitchen complete with granite table, clotted cream cabinets with architectural details and stone-effect porcelain floor. I don't think I will ever be able to move because I have not seen a more perfect small kitchen in the whole metropolitan area!
 
 I have to add that the work took approximately 2 months, and not only was the workmanship impeccable but also the workers were extremely nice and kept the area very clean. I recommended Elite Kitchen and Bath to a friend in Manhattan and she was also thrilled with her new kitchen and hand-crafted entryway cabinet and dining room buffet.
 
 As I contemplate my next project this spring, I have no other contractor but Express Contracting in mind to perform the work.

Hope H.

My husband and I hired Elite to remodel our kitchen. We had an excellent experience with this company. The owner, the designer and the craftsmen were all top notch. From start to finish, the work was completed in a timely fashion.”

George K.

The most precise workmanship, great help as needed and timely delivered work.
 They did 2appartmant renovation, 1 complete house built by them and all project was completed for maximum satisfaction.

KJ J.

I hired Elite to redo my kitchen after I had three pipes burst. I had the pleasure of working with Rob. Rob is thoughtful, thorough, responsive, and creative. I read a NYTimes article around this time about how to modernize your kitchen. Between that and working with Rob, I was able to add all of fun details (e.g., lemans, soft close, oak finishes, easy-to-clean materials, space behind/under cabinets to easily add/fix things in the future, etc.) you’d want to make the kitchen beautiful and usable were included. It took 12-13 weeks for the cabinets to come from Italy (but Elite has other options if you don’t want to wait), but Rob kept us in the loop the entire time. I’d definitely work with Elite and Rob again.

Kamran S.

Very nice people. It was a pleasure meeting with Mr. DaSilva. He will care for you and your budget.

 

Chester Gittleman

Elite Kitchen & Bath custom-designed a beautiful, highly functional, and extremely high-quality kitchen wall unit to replace an aging one. He was patient, listened carefully and made minor adjustments until the design was exactly what we wanted, then followed through with the sourcing of materials from overseas and final assembly by expert installers. All of this proceeded while the world was in the throes of the COVID-19 pandemic. Old vs. new wall units are pictured. We couldn't be more pleased with the result.

Visit our Showroom Tuesdays - Fridays - 10:00 am - 6:00 pm and Saturdays - 10:00 am - 5:00 pm

983 Northern Blvd, Manhasset, NY 11030 - (Minutes off the L.I.E. Lakeville Rd exit.) Parking in front or rear of building. 

Make an appointment for a complimentary consultation. 516-365-0595

Daniel B.

After God created the heavens and earth, separated the seas and skies, gathered the water and grew the vegetation he decided to rest on the seventh day. What the authors of the Bible failed to document was that on that day, an overwhelming hunger manifested in him, one that could not be satisfied with only his writings BUT needed to also show The North Shore of Long Island what great construction and remodeling is. So, "The Great" Elite Kitchen and Bath was created to take care of everyone's home remodeling needs here on earth and we are all that much better and happy for it. Thru time "The Great" Elite Kitchen and Bath decided to create NY's Best and most aesthetically pleasing kitchen and bath's and the rest as they say is history. Elite Kitchen and Bath managed the bathroom remodel (soup to nuts) of my wife and mine and definitely did an extraordinary job (to say the least) and we couldn't be happier. The owners along with their unbelievably talented staff are "The Tops" as Mel Tormae would say. Elite is to kitchen and bath arts what Glen is to carpentry -"A TRUE VISIONARY!"- So in conclusion, don't walk BUT run to Elite because you don't want them, you NEED them for all your remodeling needs.
 xoxoxoxoxo Jen & Dan 

Ron D.

The Elite Kitchen and Bath and Express Contracting Team and Owners provide exceptional service and work. They renovated a home for us years ago and later, an apartment in NYC. Honesty, integrity, high-quality workmanship and products, are terms that apply to them. They recently made some updates to our NYC apartment that they renovated for us several years ago. We enjoyed the same attention to detail and fine service for our small updates as we received when they performed our full renovations. You can count on a seamless and worry-free experience, plus you absolutely feel as if though, you are their only client, in that they focus fully at all times on your job and your concerns.

Linda Spring

Mr Sharabani owner of Elite kitchen and bath were wonderful. They remodeled my kitchen and bathroom and painted the apartment. His staff and workers were just great and I would recommend Elite kitchen and bath highly

Martin G.

I can’t say enough about the team at Elite Kitchen & Bath. They are masterful. Robin Dasilva was a huge help in renovating my NYC kitchen. And Yeheskel Sharbani was a genius in design. The two of them were great to work with. Always available and they oversaw every detail of the job. The workmen they used were also great. And as nice as can be. The job turned out even better than I expected. I would highly recommend them.
